questions.scenario: Summer vacations are here and a huge group of relatives (Bua, Mama, and cousins) suddenly arrives at your house. What is your first instinct?

options.text: Run to the door with a big smile, touch the elders' feet, grab their bags, and offer them cold Roohafza.
Quickly count the people, figure out where everyone will sleep, and mentally plan the morning bathroom schedule.
Rush to the guest room to put on the 'good' bedsheets and arrange a beautiful snack tray before they sit down.
Sit in the drawing-room with the adults, manage the conversations, and keep everyone entertained and happy.

questions.scenario: You are attending a massive, chaotic Indian wedding. What part of the function naturally catches your attention?

options.text: Standing near the entrance with the hosts, greeting incoming guests, and directing them to the food counters.
Noticing if the catering staff is refilling the paneer fast enough and if the used plates are being cleared quickly.
Admiring the grand floral decorations, the stage lighting, and the aesthetic setup of the bride's entry.
Watching the bride's father handle the panicked vendors and mentally thinking about how much the whole setup must have cost.

questions.scenario: Your family reaches a hotel in Manali or Goa for a vacation. What do you do immediately at the reception?

options.text: Start chatting warmly with the receptionist, ask about local sightseeing spots, and smoothly ask for a free room upgrade.
Take the keys, go to the room, inspect if the bathroom is perfectly clean, and check if the AC/Heater is actually working.
Run straight to the balcony to check the scenic view and take pictures of the beautiful hotel lobby aesthetics.
Read the hotel rulebook, check the complimentary breakfast timings, and analyze if the package was a good financial deal.

questions.scenario: Your class is organizing the 10th standard school farewell party. What is your role?

options.text: The Welcome Committee: You stand at the gate, welcoming the teachers, and showing them to their VIP seats with a smile.
The Logistics Head: You create a strict timeline for the speeches, dance performances, and when the food buffet should open.
The Decor Head: You design the photo-booth, select the balloon colors, and decide on a cool theme like 'Bollywood Retro'.
The Core Coordinator: You manage all the teams, delegate tasks, and resolve fights between the music and food committees.

questions.scenario: You are out for a nice family dinner, and the waiter accidentally brings the wrong dish. How do you react?

options.text: Politely but firmly call the waiter, explain the mix-up with a smile, and ensure nobody at the table gets upset.
Calculate how much extra time it will take to replace the dish and check the final bill later to ensure it wasn't charged twice.
Ignore the mistake for a minute to admire how beautifully the wrong dish was plated, and click a quick aesthetic food picture.
Ask to speak to the restaurant manager and smoothly negotiate a complimentary dessert to make up for the inconvenience.

questions.scenario: You are hosting a birthday party for your best friend at your house. What keeps you busy?

options.text: Standing near the door, excitedly hugging friends as they arrive, taking their gifts, and introducing people to each other.
Checking if there are enough paper plates, ensuring the cold drinks are actually chilled, and constantly clearing the trash.
Setting up the perfect Instagram-worthy backdrop with fairy lights and ordering a highly customized, gorgeous cake.
Keeping a hawk-eye on the whole crowd, ensuring no one breaks Mummy's expensive vases, and managing the pizza budget.

questions.scenario: Your school takes you on an overnight bus/train trip. How do you behave during the journey?

options.text: Moving up and down the aisle, chatting with different friend groups, playing Antakshari, and keeping the energy high.
Making sure all the luggage is securely packed under the seats and mentally doing a headcount after every single snack stop.
Securing the window seat to enjoy the scenic views and curating the perfect Spotify travel playlist for the vibe.
Coordinating with the teachers, making sure the driver knows the best route, and handling any motion-sickness emergencies.

questions.scenario: Your society is organizing a Diwali Mela and your group has put up a food stall. What are you doing?

options.text: Standing outside the stall, loudly and happily inviting aunties and uncles to come try your mom's special Pav Bhaji.
Keeping a strict inventory of exactly how many Pavs are left, managing the cashbox, and returning exact change.
Decorating your stall with bright dupattas, marigold flowers, and writing a beautiful, colorful menu board with chalk.
Walking around to spy on the other society stalls to see what they are pricing their dishes at, adjusting your prices accordingly.

questions.scenario: Mummy's kitty party friends drop by the house completely unannounced. What is your immediate reaction?

options.text: Immediately smile, greet them warmly with a 'Namaste', and engage them in polite small talk about your studies.
Rush to the kitchen to quickly check if there is enough milk for tea and see if there is enough namkeen in the jars.
Quickly bring out the 'special guest-only' fancy tea set and arrange the biscuits on a beautiful serving tray.
Take control of the situation: signal your younger sibling to quickly hide the drawing-room mess while you distract the guests.

questions.scenario: When you play a board game like Business/Monopoly with your cousins, what is your play style?

options.text: The cheerful player who constantly talks, cracks jokes, distracts others, and makes the game fun for everyone.
The meticulous player who organizes their notes by color, counts every rupee, and ensures nobody skips paying rent.
The aesthetic player who arranges all their little plastic houses and hotels perfectly neatly on the board just because it looks satisfying.
The Banker. You control the money flow and make aggressive strategic deals with other players to dominate the board.

Guest_Relations.title: The Face of Hospitality (Front Office / Guest Relations)
Guest_Relations.primary_match_text: You are a total people person! You have fantastic energy, a warm smile, and you love making people feel special. You are great at talking your way through tricky situations and ensuring everyone has a good time.
Guest_Relations.day_in_the_life: Standing at the grand reception of a 5-star hotel, welcoming international VIP guests, handling high-pressure check-ins, solving immediate guest complaints, and ensuring 100% customer satisfaction.
Guest_Relations.alternative_match_text: If not hotel management, your incredible communication skills would make you a fantastic Cabin Crew Member (Flight Attendant), Public Relations (PR) Manager, or TV Anchor.
Guest_Relations.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Any Stream. Entrance: Crack the NCHMCT JEE (National Council for Hotel Management Joint Entrance Examination). Degree: 3-year B.Sc in Hospitality and Hotel Administration or Bachelor of Hotel Management (BHM).

Operations_Manager.title: The Systems Master (Hotel Operations / Revenue Manager)
Operations_Manager.primary_match_text: You are highly organized, logical, and detail-oriented. You like systems to run perfectly and hate wasting resources. You are the hidden backbone that keeps a massive hotel running smoothly behind the scenes.
Operations_Manager.day_in_the_life: Managing a massive housekeeping staff, ensuring 500+ rooms are spotless, checking kitchen food inventory, and calculating the perfect room prices during peak tourist seasons to maximize profit.
Operations_Manager.alternative_match_text: Your love for systems and detail would also make you a brilliant Supply Chain Manager, Logistics Expert, or Financial Analyst.
Operations_Manager.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Any Stream (Commerce/Math is a bonus). Entrance: NCHMCT JEE. Degree: B.Sc in Hospitality and Hotel Administration or BBA in Hospitality Operations. Next Steps: Specialize in Revenue Management or Accommodation Operations.

Event_Designer.title: The Experience Creator (Event & Banquet Designer)
Event_Designer.primary_match_text: You are highly creative, aesthetic, and visual. You know that hospitality isn't just about food and beds; it's about creating magical, unforgettable experiences that look beautiful.
Event_Designer.day_in_the_life: Planning massive, multi-crore Indian weddings at luxury resorts, selecting grand floral themes, coordinating with lighting experts, and designing beautiful buffet layouts.
Event_Designer.alternative_match_text: With your amazing visual creativity, you would also excel as an Interior Designer, Fashion Stylist, or Creative Director.
Event_Designer.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Any Stream. Entrance: NCHMCT JEE or direct admissions. Degree: Bachelor of Hotel Management (BHM) or a specialized BA/BBA in Event Management. Next Steps: Intern with premium wedding planning companies.

General_Manager.title: The Hospitality Boss (General Manager / Hotel Owner)
General_Manager.primary_match_text: You are a natural leader, a strategic thinker, and a boss. You understand the big picture—how to manage a large team, handle budgets, and make sure the business is highly profitable.
General_Manager.day_in_the_life: Overseeing the entire 5-star property, taking meetings with department heads, reviewing the hotel's financial profits, schmoozing with celebrity clients, and making the final executive decisions.
General_Manager.alternative_match_text: Your incredible leadership and business mindset would make you an outstanding Corporate CEO, Entrepreneur, or Real Estate Developer.
General_Manager.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Any Stream (Commerce preferred). Entrance: NCHMCT JEE. Degree: B.Sc in Hospitality/BHM. Next Steps: Work your way up through hotel departments and pursue an MBA in Hospitality Management to reach the top management level.
